node.statement: Let v(lambda)=lambda I_A and v_n=1_{M_n} tensor v. By def-extended-epsilon-cstar-algebra, U_n=I_n tensor I_A is the designated unit of the epsilon-C*-algebra M_n tensor A, so v_n is linear, v_n(I_n)=U_n, and v_n(X^*)=v_n(X)^dagger because I_A^dagger=I_A. Moreover v_n(X)v_n(Y)-v_n(XY)=v_n(XY)U_n-v_n(XY); the defining approximate right-unit axiom at level n, node 1.1, ||XY||<=||X||||Y|| in M_n, and ||I_A||<=1+epsilon give ||v_n(X)v_n(Y)-v_n(XY)||_n<=epsilon||v_n(XY)||_n=epsilon||XY||||I_A||<=epsilon(1+epsilon)||X||||Y||<=2epsilon||X||||Y|| for epsilon<=1/2. Thus every v_n is a 2epsilon-homomorphism.
